en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the gym.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Gonta like moving body. Gonta used
to roughhouse with forest family.

We be able to understand each other
by roughhousing!

Oh, but not every time!
And always shake hands first!
Feels good to move body and clean up!
Let's clean everything and surprise everyone!

Gonta too pushy. Shoulda noticed
Shuichi tired...

<CLT=cltMIND>Gonta is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
